items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 30 at 1:06PM AKDT until October 1 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts near 40 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...From 7 AM to 1 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
Strong winds could make docking high profile vessels difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...While gusty winds will impact the area through
tonight, the strongest winds are expected Thursday morning.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 30 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Periods of snow continue through Friday night before gradually
drying on Saturday. Between Wednesday and Friday, snowfall totals
will range from 2 to 4 inches. Isolated locations under any
persistent heavier snow may see up to 6 inches.

Winds will be strongest today near Utqiagvik (Barrow) then weaken
tomorrow, but strongest Thursday night into Friday from Nuiqsut
to Kaktovik. Wind gusts will be up to 30 mph which may result in
areas of blowing/drifting snow, lowering visibility at times.
items.areas: Northern Arctic Coast; Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 30 at 6:02AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
With widespread colder weather across the Interior, another front
will bring light snow to the area Wednesday night into Thursday
morning. Generally, about 1 inch or less is expected around
Fairbanks, although some isolated locations could receive locally
higher amounts. Towards the Chena Recreational Area, Chena Hot
Springs, White Mountains and Fortymile Country, snow totals will
be around 1 to 3 inches. Drier weather returns by Friday.
items.areas: Dalton Highway Summits; White Mountains and High Terrain South of the Yukon River; Fortymile Country; Upper Chena River Valley; Eielson AFB and Salcha; Chatanika River Valley; Two Rivers; Fairbanks Metro Area

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued September 30 at 5:56AM AKDT until October 1 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 6 and 11
inches.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 10 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult to impossible. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow may melt initially Wednesday afternoon
but will quickly begin to accumulate Wednesday night as
temperatures drop below freezing with moderate to heavy snow
fall
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp; Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.
